cards.name: Body and Soul
cards.designIntent: Provide persistent supplemental defense without guaranteeing protection on a specific turn.

base.text: Each incoming Attack hit has a 20% chance to miss. This benefit does not stack.
effects: Set the combat dodge benefit to 20% if it improves the previous benefit.

card.text: Each incoming Attack hit has a 30% chance to miss. This benefit does not stack.
effects: Set the combat dodge benefit to 30% if it improves the previous benefit.

rulesNotes: Roll independently for each incoming Attack hit, including individual multihits.
A miss prevents the hit damage before consuming Block. This does not promise to cancel non-damage effects of the enemy move.
Use the highest benefit granted this combat. Equal or weaker copies are unplayable, following Fortitude.
An upgrade after the base replaces 20% with 30%; it does not add 30 percentage points.
Reset benefit tracking after combat.
Does not dodge HP-loss or non-Attack damage.
cards.balanceNotes: Test damage variance, lethal-hit reliability, and interaction with Surrender. Do not allow additive copies to reach guaranteed immunity.

cards.name: Mental Fortitude
cards.designIntent: Trade direct Attack strength for repeatable defensive and potentially DoT scaling.

base.text: Gain 2 Dexterity and 2 Mastery. Lose 2 Strength.
effects: Gain 2 Dexterity.
Gain 2 Mastery.
Lose 2 Strength.

upgrade.summary: Provisional: gain 3 Dexterity and 3 Mastery; retain the 2 Strength loss.

card.text: Gain 3 Dexterity and 3 Mastery. Lose 2 Strength.
effects: Gain 3 Dexterity.
Gain 3 Mastery.
Lose 2 Strength.

rulesNotes: PARTIALLY UNRESOLVED: losing 2 Strength rather than losing Mastery is confirmed; no Exhaust is intended.
This draft retains the original Dexterity AND Mastery gains. Confirmation is still pending whether only Dexterity should remain.
The original 2-energy cost and 2/3 stat gains are retained provisionally, not newly approved.
Stats last for combat.
Mastery can be negative; damaging DoT ticks floor at zero without removing their stacks or changing Madness into a ticking effect.
Resolve Artifact/cleansing behavior for the Strength penalty under normal stat-debuff rules before implementation.
cards.balanceNotes: Do not implement until the retained benefits and final cost are confirmed. Test repeated use, reduced Attack damage, and Penance conversion.

art.direction: Verify and use the actual WoW ability icon inside the shared card frame before implementation.

cards.name: Insidious Ire
cards.designIntent: Reward full DoT setup with Mastery-scaling multihit Attack damage.

base.text: Each Attack hit against an enemy with Touch, Pain, and Madness deals 1 additional damage plus your Mastery, to a minimum bonus of 0.
effects: For each direct Attack hit, check whether its target currently has Touch, Pain, and Madness.
If qualified, add max(0, 1 + current Mastery) damage to that hit.

upgrade.summary: Increase the per-hit base bonus from 1 to 2; Mastery scaling stays at 1 per point.

card.text: Each Attack hit against an enemy with Touch, Pain, and Madness deals 2 additional damage plus your Mastery, to a minimum bonus of 0.
effects: For each direct Attack hit, check whether its target currently has Touch, Pain, and Madness.
If qualified, add max(0, 2 + current Mastery) damage to that hit.

rulesNotes: Bonus is per hit, including every hit of X-cost cards, not once per card.
Use current Mastery and current qualifying DoTs separately for each hit.
The bonus is strictly additive and never negative. Negative Mastery may eliminate it but must never cause this Power to lower Attack damage.
The upgrade does not grant Mastery.
DoT ticks and Halo are not direct Attack hits and receive no bonus.
Copies stack their contributions; apply the nonnegative bonus in normal Attack calculations before power modifiers and Voidform amplification.
cards.balanceNotes: Approved initial formula; 2 energy remains the provisional testing cost. Watch high-Mastery X-cost bursts and Voidform amplification.

cards.name: Petrifying Scream
cards.designIntent: Buy a setup and DoT turn by interrupting one enemy action.

base.text: Stun the target for 1 turn. Exhaust.
effects: Apply 1 turn of Stun to the target.
Exhaust.

card.text: Stun the target for 1 turn. Exhaust.
effects: Apply 1 turn of Stun to the target.
Exhaust.

rulesNotes: Artifact can block Stun.
Natural DoT ticks still resolve during the skipped enemy action.
Only one Skill design exists; the duplicate Power listing was a mistake.
Multiple copies can stun on consecutive turns; no additional immunity rule has been approved.
cards.balanceNotes: Rare placement reflects prevention plus an extra DoT/setup turn. Validate boss action sequences, consecutive stuns, and Embrace healing.

cards.name: Shadow Committal
cards.designIntent: Convert cards played during a burst window into lasting combat scaling.

base.text: During Voidform, playing an Attack grants 1 Strength, a Skill grants 1 Dexterity, and a Power grants 1 Mastery.
effects: While Voidform is active, grant the corresponding stat after each triggering Attack, Skill, or Power resolves.

card.text: During Voidform, playing an Attack grants 1 Strength, a Skill grants 1 Dexterity, and a Power grants 1 Mastery.
effects: While Voidform is active, grant the corresponding stat after each triggering Attack, Skill, or Power resolves.

rulesNotes: Granted stats persist until combat ends, including after ordinary Voidform ends.
Resolve each stat gain after its triggering card, so the triggering Attack does not benefit from the Strength it generates.
This Power initial play does not trigger its own newly applied effect.
Works during Surrender lasting Voidform; no additional cap or restriction was approved.
Copies stack. Sample Voidform eligibility at play time, not after resolving a card that enters Voidform.
cards.balanceNotes: Keep proposed values for initial testing. Evaluate both successful Surrender combinations and hands burdened by expensive setup Powers.
